content: Less than 24 hours ago, social media posts about Grand Theft Auto 6 were flooded with thirsty images of Lucia Caminos, the first female protagonist in Rockstar's open-world series. Now that the game is playable in some regions of the world, much of that enthusiasm has transferred to an entirely new character who hasn't appeared in any of the game's screenshots or marketing. Meet Mandy, GTA 6 's new it girl.
